findings.title: Able2Shell: N-central zero-day collection published by Oracle-Security
findings.summary_md: A researcher operating as Oracle-Security published the Able2Shell write-up in the account's CVEs repository, describing 33 alleged vulnerabilities in N-able N-central with proof-of-concept code. Tenable's FAQ records the earliest README commit at 2026-11-09 04:14 UTC. The collection includes an unauthenticated command-execution chain and was tested against N-central Appliance 2026.4.0.31.

findings.title: N-able disables cloud services following disclosure of Able2Shell exploit chains
findings.summary_md: Huntress reports that N-able took its hosted N-central environments offline and released 2026.4 HF2 on November 10 to address the Able2Shell issues disclosed the day before. N-able stated it had not seen active exploitation of the vulnerabilities. Huntress advised administrators to review authentication activity from November 8 onward and to assess every client network managed by an N-central server.

findings.title: N-able takes cloud platform offline after 30-plus zero-days published
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer reports that N-able took hosted N-central environments offline after a researcher publicly disclosed more than 30 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities. The disclosure included exploits that could let attackers take over vulnerable N-central servers. N-able advised on-premises customers to shut down servers until further notice.

findings.title: Emerging threat: critical vulnerabilities in N-able N-central
findings.summary_md: Beazley Security reported exploitation attempts against N-able N-central honeypots overnight after Able2Shell proof-of-concept code surfaced, with N-able reporting scanning activity tied to the published exploit code. The advisory was updated on November 10, 2026. No confirmed compromise of a customer server had been reported at that time.

findings.title: N-able N-central Able2Shell vulnerabilities: find impacted installs
findings.summary_md: runZero published guidance for finding N-central installations affected by Able2Shell, describing an unauthenticated XML external entity issue chained with session confusion to remote code execution as the nable user. The post was published on November 9, 2026. It complements N-able's later hotfix guidance for administrators.

findings.title: Able2Shell: N-central zero-days and the RMM kill switch
findings.summary_md: The Cloud Security Alliance published a research note stating the Able2Shell repository appeared at roughly 04:14 UTC on November 9 under the Oracle-Security account and that the disclosure was made without prior notice to the vendor. It notes N-able took hosted N-central environments offline across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific within hours. The note was published on November 10, 2026.

findings.title: N-central 2026.4 HF2 release notes
findings.summary_md: N-able published release notes for N-central 2026.4 Hotfix 2, build 2026.4.1.26, on November 10, 2026. The critical security update addresses the most critical vulnerabilities disclosed on November 9. N-able states hosted servers were upgraded and advises on-premises customers to apply the hotfix.
